01 / About

Science-trained. Strategy-minded. Story-led.

Precision from the lab.
Creativity for the real world.

I trained and worked as a Medical Laboratory Scientist, where accuracy, process and careful analysis mattered every day. I now bring that same discipline to digital marketing.

Alongside my marketing work, I founded Sips & Bites by Tems, a food and beverage business I run end to end—from product development and packaging to content, customer experience and fulfilment.

I create honest, faith-led short-form content and use performance data to understand what connects. My work sits where thoughtful storytelling, useful strategy and practical execution meet.
